; =============================================================================
; main.asm - Custom KN5000 Boot ROM: Boot Code Hexdump
; =============================================================================
; A minimal boot ROM for the Technics KN5000 that:
;   1. Initializes essential hardware (watchdog, memory, ports)
;   2. Initializes the VGA display controller
;   3. Displays hex dump of boot code from Reset_Handler on screen
;   4. Sends "It is working!" to the serial port (computer interface)
;
; Target: TMP94C241F (TLCS-900/H2) @ 25 MHz
; ROM Size: 2MB (0xE00000 - 0xFFFFFF)
; Reset Vector: 0xFFFEE0
;
; Build: make
; Test: Run in MAME kn5000 driver with custom ROM set
;
; This code reuses shared components from ../kn5000-roms-disasm/
; =============================================================================

	cpu 96c141		; TLCS-900/H target
	page 0
	maxmode on

; =============================================================================
; Include shared definitions from kn5000-roms-disasm
; =============================================================================
	include "sfr_tmp94c241.asm"
	include "vga_constants.asm"
	include "tmp94c241.inc"

; Local macros not in the disasm repo
	include "local_macros.inc"

; =============================================================================
; Memory Map Constants
; =============================================================================
STACK_TOP		EQU 001000h	; Stack in internal RAM
OFFSCREEN_BUFFER_1	EQU 280000h	; Offscreen buffer (required by vga_init)

; Screen dimensions
SCREEN_WIDTH		EQU 320
SCREEN_HEIGHT		EQU 240

; Colors (palette indices)
COLOR_BLACK		EQU 0
COLOR_WHITE		EQU 1
COLOR_CYAN		EQU 2		; Address text
COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY	EQU 3		; Borders/separator
COLOR_YELLOW		EQU 4		; Title text
COLOR_DARK_BLUE		EQU 8

; RAM variables (internal RAM, above SFR region)
TEXT_COLOR		EQU 000100h	; 1 byte: current drawing color
ADDR_BUF		EQU 000101h	; 3 bytes: address display value (little-endian)

; Serial port constants
SC0MOD_8N1		EQU 069h	; 8-bit, no parity, 1 stop, baud gen
BR0CR_38400		EQU 006h	; 38400 baud

; =============================================================================
; ROM Layout
; =============================================================================
	org 0E00000h		; Program ROM base address

; Fill with 0xFF until code section
	rept 0F0000h		; ~960KB of padding
	db 0FFh
	endm

; =============================================================================
; Code Section (starts at 0xEF0000)
; =============================================================================
	org 0EF0000h

; Jump to Reset_Handler (VGA code is included first for macro definitions)
	jp Reset_Handler

; =============================================================================
; Include shared VGA I/O and initialization routines
; (defines Write_VGA_Register, VGA_Setup, and macros like VGA_SEQUENCER)
; =============================================================================
	include "vga_io.asm"
	include "vga_init.asm"
	ret			; VGA_Setup has no ret (designed for inline use)

; =============================================================================
; Entry Point - Called after hardware reset                      [0xEF09C5]
; =============================================================================
Reset_Handler:
	; =========================================================================
	; Minimal hardware initialization (local, trimmed from original)
	; Initializes: watchdog, clock, ports, memory controller, DRAM
	; =========================================================================
	include "boot_hw_init.asm"

	; Set up stack pointer (after hardware init)
	LDA_XWA_IMM24 STACK_TOP
	ld XSP, XWA

	; Initialize VGA display using shared code
	CALR VGA_Setup

	; The shared VGA_Setup leaves registers set for buffer init:
	;   XWA = OFFSCREEN_BUFFER_1, BC = 0808h, DE = 38400
	; We skip the offscreen buffer stuff and just clear video RAM directly

	; Clear screen to dark blue
	CALR Clear_Screen

	; Set up additional palette colors (cyan, light gray, yellow)
	CALR Setup_Palette

	; Draw hexdump of boot code with UI
	CALR Draw_Hexdump

	; Turn screen on (sequencer clocking mode)
	VGA_SEQUENCER 01h, 001h

	; TODO: Re-enable serial port code after VGA troubleshooting
	; CALR Serial_Init
	; CALR Send_Serial_Message

	; Enter infinite loop
Main_Loop:						; [0xEF0B36]
	halt
	jr Main_Loop

; =============================================================================
; Default_Handler - Default interrupt handler for unused vectors [0xEF0B39]
; =============================================================================
Default_Handler:
	halt
	jr Default_Handler

; =============================================================================
; Clear_Screen - Fill screen with dark blue (color 8)            [0xEF0B3C]
; =============================================================================
Clear_Screen:
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	ld XBC, SCREEN_WIDTH * SCREEN_HEIGHT	; 76800 bytes
	ld A, COLOR_DARK_BLUE

.clear_loop:
	ld (XDE), A
	inc 1, XDE
	dec 1, XBC
	or XBC, XBC		; Set Z flag based on full 32-bit value
	jr NZ, .clear_loop

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Hexdump - Display hex dump of boot code from Reset_Handler
; 8 bytes per line, 28 lines = 224 bytes
; Centered: 64px left margin, 8px top margin
; Input: none
; Uses: XHL = source address, XDE = screen position, B = byte counter, C = line counter
; =============================================================================
Draw_Hexdump:
	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Reset_Handler	; Source: boot code in ROM
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	add XDE, 8 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 64	; Top-left: Y=8, X=64

	ld C, 28			; 28 lines

.line_loop:
	push XDE			; Save line start position
	ld B, 8				; 8 bytes per line

.byte_loop:
	push XHL
	push BC
	ld A, (XHL)			; Read byte from ROM
	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte		; Draw "XX " and advance XDE by 24
	pop BC
	pop XHL

	inc 1, XHL			; Next source byte
	dec 1, B
	or B, B
	jr NZ, .byte_loop

	pop XDE				; Restore line start
	add XDE, 8 * SCREEN_WIDTH	; Move down one character row (8 pixels)
	dec 1, C
	or C, C
	jr NZ, .line_loop

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Hex_Byte - Draw one byte as two hex digits plus space gap
; Input: A = byte value, XDE = screen position
; Output: XDE advanced by 24 pixels (3 char widths)
; =============================================================================
Draw_Hex_Byte:
	push WA				; Save original byte

	; High nibble
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Char
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 8			; Advance one char width

	; Low nibble
	pop WA				; Restore original byte
	and A, 0Fh
	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Char
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 16			; Advance past char + space gap

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Nibble_To_Ascii - Convert 0-15 to ASCII '0'-'9' or 'A'-'F'
; Input: A = nibble (0-15)
; Output: A = ASCII character
; =============================================================================
Nibble_To_Ascii:
	cp A, 10
	jr C, .digit
	add A, 'A' - 10
	ret
.digit:
	add A, '0'
	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_String - Draw null-terminated string at screen position   [0xEF0B67]
; Input: XHL = string pointer, XDE = screen position (VRAM address)
; =============================================================================
Draw_String:
.draw_loop:
	ld A, (XHL)
	or A, A			; Check for null terminator
	ret Z

	push XDE
	push XHL
	CALR Draw_Char		; Draw character at (XDE), char in A
	pop XHL
	pop XDE

	add XDE, 8		; Move to next character position
	inc 1, XHL
	jr .draw_loop

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Char - Draw a single 8x8 character                        [0xEF0B7E]
; Input: A = ASCII character, XDE = screen position
; =============================================================================
Draw_Char:
	; Calculate font data offset: (A - 32) * 8
	sub A, 32		; ASCII offset
	EXTZ_WA			; Zero-extend A to WA (clears W)
	EXTZ_XWA		; Zero-extend WA to XWA (clears upper 16 bits)

	; Multiply by 8 (shift left 3)
	sla 1, WA
	sla 1, WA
	sla 1, WA

	; Get font data address
	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Font_8x8
	add XHL, XWA

	; Draw 8 rows
	ld C, 8			; Row counter

.row_loop:
	ld A, (XHL)		; Get font row bitmap
	push XDE
	push XHL

	; Draw 8 pixels
	ld B, 8			; Column counter

.pixel_loop:
	bit 7, A		; Test MSB
	jr Z, .skip_pixel

	; Draw pixel in current text color
	push WA
	ld A, (TEXT_COLOR)
	ld (XDE), A
	pop WA

.skip_pixel:
	inc 1, XDE
	sla 1, A		; Shift to next bit
	dec 1, B
	or B, B
	jr NZ, .pixel_loop

	pop XHL
	pop XDE

	; Move to next row
	add XDE, SCREEN_WIDTH
	inc 1, XHL
	dec 1, C
	or C, C
	jr NZ, .row_loop

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Serial_Init - Initialize SC0 for computer interface (38400)    [0xEF0BC1]
; =============================================================================
Serial_Init:
	ld (SC0MOD), SC0MOD_8N1
	ld (BR0CR), BR0CR_38400
	ld (SC0CR), 000h
	ret

; =============================================================================
; Send_Serial_Message - Send "It is working!" to serial port     [0xEF0BCB]
; =============================================================================
Send_Serial_Message:
	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Str_ItIsWorking

.send_loop:
	ld A, (XHL)
	or A, A			; Check for null terminator
	ret Z

	CALR Serial_Send_Byte
	inc 1, XHL
	jr .send_loop

; =============================================================================
; Serial_Send_Byte - Send single byte via SC0                    [0xEF0BDD]
; Input: A = byte to send
; =============================================================================
Serial_Send_Byte:
	push BC
	push DE

	; Wait for TX buffer empty (bit 1 of SC0CR) with timeout
	ld DE, 0FFFFh		; Timeout counter
.wait_tx_empty:
	ld C, (SC0CR)
	bit 1, C
	jr NZ, .tx_ready
	dec 1, DE
	or DE, DE
	jr NZ, .wait_tx_empty
	jr .send_done		; Timeout - skip send

.tx_ready:
	ld (SC0BUF), A

.send_done:
	pop DE
	pop BC
	ret

; =============================================================================
; Data Section
; =============================================================================
Str_ItIsWorking:				; [0xEF0C04]
	db "It is working!", 13, 10, 0

; =============================================================================
; Font Data
; =============================================================================
	include "font_8x8.asm"

; =============================================================================
; Reset Handler Location                                         [0xFFFEE0]
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFEE0h

Reset_Entry:
	jp Reset_Handler

; =============================================================================
; Fill gap between reset entry and vector table
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFEE4h

	rept 01Ch
	db 0FFh
	endm

; =============================================================================
; Interrupt Vector Table                                         [0xFFFF00]
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFF00h

VECTOR_TABLE:
	dd 00FFFEE0h		; Vector 0: Reset
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 1
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 2
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 3
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 4
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 5
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 6
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 7

	rept 56
	dd Default_Handler
	endm

; =============================================================================
; End of ROM
; =============================================================================
	end

COLOR_WHITE		EQU 1
COLOR_CYAN		EQU 2		; Address text
COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY	EQU 3		; Borders/separator

COLOR_DARK_BLUE		EQU 8

; RAM variables (internal RAM, above SFR region)

ADDR_BUF		EQU 000101h	; 3 bytes: address display value (little-endian)

; Serial port constants

; =============================================================================
; ROM Layout
; =============================================================================

; Fill with 0xFF until code section

	db 0FFh
	endm

; =============================================================================
; Code Section (starts at 0xEF0000)

; =============================================================================

; (defines Write_VGA_Register, VGA_Setup, and macros like VGA_SEQUENCER)

	jr Default_Handler

	inc 1, XDE
	dec 1, XBC

	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Str_Title
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	add XDE, 4 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 72	; Y=4, X=72

	add XDE, 17 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 36 ; Y=17, X=36 (inside border)

	push XHL			; Save source pointer
	push BC				; Save counters

	pop XDE

	; Middle byte of address (byte 1)

	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 16			; Advance past 2 chars

	; Low byte of address (byte 0)

	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 16 + 8		; Advance past 2 chars + separator gap

	; --- Draw 8 data bytes in white ---

	pop BC				; Restore counters
	pop XHL				; Restore source pointer
	ld B, 8				; 8 bytes per line

.byte_loop:
	push XHL
	push BC
	ld A, (XHL)			; Read byte from ROM
	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte		; Draw "XX " and advance XDE by 24
	pop BC
	pop XHL

	inc 1, XHL			; Next source byte
	dec 1, B
	or B, B
	jr NZ, .byte_loop

	; --- Increment address buffer by 8 ---
	ld A, (ADDR_BUF)
	add A, 8
	ld (ADDR_BUF), A
	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 1)
	adc A, 0
	ld (ADDR_BUF + 1), A
	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 2)
	adc A, 0
	ld (ADDR_BUF + 2), A

	; --- Move to next line ---
	pop XDE				; Restore line start
	add XDE, 8 * SCREEN_WIDTH	; Move down one character row (8 pixels)
	dec 1, C
	or C, C
	jr NZ, .line_loop

	ret

; =============================================================================

; Input: A = byte value, XDE = screen position
; Output: XDE advanced by 24 pixels (3 char widths)
; =============================================================================
Draw_Hex_Byte:
	push WA				; Save original byte

	; High nibble
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Char
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 8			; Advance one char width

	; Low nibble
	pop WA				; Restore original byte

	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Char
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 16			; Advance past char + space gap

	ret

; =============================================================================

; Input: A = nibble (0-15)
; Output: A = ASCII character
; =============================================================================

	cp A, 10
	jr C, .digit

	ret

	add A, '0'
	ret

; =============================================================================

	push XDE
	push XHL
	CALR Draw_Char		; Draw character at (XDE), char in A
	pop XHL
	pop XDE

	add XDE, 8		; Move to next character position
	inc 1, XHL
	jr .draw_loop

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Char - Draw a single 8x8 character                        [0xEF0B7E]
; Input: A = ASCII character, XDE = screen position
; =============================================================================
Draw_Char:
	; Calculate font data offset: (A - 32) * 8
	sub A, 32		; ASCII offset
	EXTZ_WA			; Zero-extend A to WA (clears W)
	EXTZ_XWA		; Zero-extend WA to XWA (clears upper 16 bits)

	; Multiply by 8 (shift left 3)
	sla 1, WA
	sla 1, WA
	sla 1, WA

	; Get font data address
	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Font_8x8
	add XHL, XWA

	; Draw 8 rows
	ld C, 8			; Row counter

.row_loop:
	ld A, (XHL)		; Get font row bitmap
	push XDE
	push XHL

	; Draw 8 pixels
	ld B, 8			; Column counter

.pixel_loop:
	bit 7, A		; Test MSB
	jr Z, .skip_pixel

	; Draw pixel in current text color
	push WA
	ld A, (TEXT_COLOR)
	ld (XDE), A
	pop WA

.skip_pixel:
	inc 1, XDE
	sla 1, A		; Shift to next bit
	dec 1, B
	or B, B
	jr NZ, .pixel_loop

	pop XHL
	pop XDE

	; Move to next row
	add XDE, SCREEN_WIDTH
	inc 1, XHL
	dec 1, C
	or C, C
	jr NZ, .row_loop

	ret

; =============================================================================

	ld (SC0MOD), SC0MOD_8N1
	ld (BR0CR), BR0CR_38400
	ld (SC0CR), 000h
	ret

; =============================================================================

	ld A, (XHL)
	or A, A			; Check for null terminator
	ret Z

	inc 1, XHL
	jr .send_loop

; =============================================================================
; Serial_Send_Byte - Send single byte via SC0                    [0xEF0BDD]
; Input: A = byte to send
; =============================================================================

	push BC
	push DE

	; Wait for TX buffer empty (bit 1 of SC0CR) with timeout
	ld DE, 0FFFFh		; Timeout counter
.wait_tx_empty:
	ld C, (SC0CR)
	bit 1, C
	jr NZ, .tx_ready
	dec 1, DE
	or DE, DE
	jr NZ, .wait_tx_empty
	jr .send_done		; Timeout - skip send

.tx_ready:
	ld (SC0BUF), A

.send_done:
	pop DE
	pop BC
	ret

; =============================================================================
; Data Section
; =============================================================================
Str_ItIsWorking:				; [0xEF0C04]
	db "It is working!", 13, 10, 0

; =============================================================================
; Font Data
; =============================================================================
	include "font_8x8.asm"

; =============================================================================
; Reset Handler Location                                         [0xFFFEE0]
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFEE0h

Reset_Entry:
	jp Reset_Handler

; =============================================================================
; Fill gap between reset entry and vector table
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFEE4h

	rept 01Ch
	db 0FFh
	endm

; =============================================================================
; Interrupt Vector Table                                         [0xFFFF00]
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFF00h

VECTOR_TABLE:
	dd 00FFFEE0h		; Vector 0: Reset
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 1
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 2
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 3
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 4
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 5
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 6
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 7

	rept 56
	dd Default_Handler
	endm

; =============================================================================
; End of ROM
; =============================================================================
	end

	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Ah

	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Fh

; =============================================================================

	CALR Draw_Hline

	CALR Draw_Vline

	CALR Draw_Vline

	or BC, BC
	jr NZ, Draw_Vline

	jr C, .digit

	ret

	ret

; =============================================================================

	EXTZ_XWA		; Zero-extend WA to XWA (clears upper 16 bits)

	sla 1, WA
	sla 1, WA

	add XHL, XWA

	ld A, (XHL)		; Get font row bitmap
	push XDE
	push XHL

	; Draw 8 pixels

	ld A, (TEXT_COLOR)
	ld (XDE), A
	pop WA

.skip_pixel:

	or B, B
	jr NZ, .pixel_loop

	pop XHL
	pop XDE

	dec 1, C
	or C, C
	jr NZ, .row_loop

; =============================================================================
Serial_Send_Byte:

	ret

; =============================================================================

; =============================================================================

; =============================================================================
; Fill gap between reset entry and vector table
; =============================================================================

	rept 01Ch
	db 0FFh
	endm

; =============================================================================
; Interrupt Vector Table                                         [0xFFFF00]
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFF00h

VECTOR_TABLE:
	dd 00FFFEE0h		; Vector 0: Reset
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 1
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 2
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 3
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 4
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 5
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 6
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 7

	rept 56
	dd Default_Handler
	endm

; =============================================================================
; End of ROM
; =============================================================================
	end

	include "tmp94c241.inc"

; Local macros not in the disasm repo

SCREEN_WIDTH		EQU 320

COLOR_WHITE		EQU 1

COLOR_YELLOW		EQU 4		; Title text

TEXT_COLOR		EQU 000100h	; 1 byte: current drawing color

	endm

	include "vga_init.asm"

Str_Title:
	db "KN5000 hexdump utility", 0

Str_ItIsWorking:
	db "It is working!", 13, 10, 0

; =============================================================================
; Font Data
; =============================================================================
	include "font_8x8.asm"

; =============================================================================
; Reset Handler Location                                         [0xFFFEE0]
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFEE0h

Reset_Entry:
	jp Reset_Handler

; =============================================================================
; Fill gap between reset entry and vector table
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFEE4h

	rept 01Ch
	db 0FFh
	endm

; =============================================================================
; Interrupt Vector Table                                         [0xFFFF00]
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFF00h

VECTOR_TABLE:
	dd 00FFFEE0h		; Vector 0: Reset
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 1
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 2
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 3
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 4
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 5
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 6
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 7

	rept 56
	dd Default_Handler
	endm

; =============================================================================
; End of ROM
; =============================================================================
	end

1→; =============================================================================
     2→; main.asm - Custom KN5000 Boot ROM: Hexdump Utility
     3→; =============================================================================
     4→; A minimal boot ROM for the Technics KN5000 that:
     5→;   1. Initializes essential hardware (watchdog, memory, ports)
     6→;   2. Initializes the VGA display controller
     7→;   3. Displays a hex dump viewer with title, bordered frame, colored
     8→;      address column, and data display of boot code
     9→;   4. Sends "It is working!" to the serial port (computer interface)
    10→;
    11→; Target: TMP94C241F (TLCS-900/H2) @ 25 MHz
    12→; ROM Size: 2MB (0xE00000 - 0xFFFFFF)
    13→; Reset Vector: 0xFFFEE0
    14→;
    15→; Build: make
    16→; Test: Run in MAME kn5000 driver with custom ROM set
    17→;
    18→; This code reuses shared components from ../kn5000-roms-disasm/
    19→; =============================================================================
    20→
    21→	cpu 96c141		; TLCS-900/H target
    22→	page 0
    23→	maxmode on
    24→
    25→; =============================================================================
    26→; Include shared definitions from kn5000-roms-disasm
    27→; =============================================================================
    28→	include "sfr_tmp94c241.asm"
    29→	include "vga_constants.asm"
    30→	include "tmp94c241.inc"
    31→
    32→; Local macros not in the disasm repo
    33→	include "local_macros.inc"
    34→
    35→; =============================================================================
    36→; Memory Map Constants
    37→; =============================================================================
    38→STACK_TOP		EQU 001000h	; Stack in internal RAM
    39→OFFSCREEN_BUFFER_1	EQU 280000h	; Offscreen buffer (required by vga_init)
    40→
    41→; Screen dimensions
    42→SCREEN_WIDTH		EQU 320
    43→SCREEN_HEIGHT		EQU 240
    44→
    45→; Colors (palette indices)
    46→COLOR_BLACK		EQU 0
    47→COLOR_WHITE		EQU 1
    48→COLOR_CYAN		EQU 2		; Address text
    49→COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY	EQU 3		; Borders/separator
    50→COLOR_YELLOW		EQU 4		; Title text
    51→COLOR_DARK_BLUE		EQU 8
    52→
    53→; RAM variables (internal RAM, above SFR region)
    54→TEXT_COLOR		EQU 000100h	; 1 byte: current drawing color
    55→ADDR_BUF		EQU 000101h	; 3 bytes: address display value (little-endian)
    56→
    57→; Serial port constants
    58→SC0MOD_8N1		EQU 069h	; 8-bit, no parity, 1 stop, baud gen
    59→BR0CR_38400		EQU 006h	; 38400 baud
    60→
    61→; =============================================================================
    62→; ROM Layout
    63→; =============================================================================
    64→	org 0E00000h		; Program ROM base address
    65→
    66→; Fill with 0xFF until code section
    67→	rept 0F0000h		; ~960KB of padding
    68→	db 0FFh
    69→	endm
    70→
    71→; =============================================================================
    72→; Code Section (starts at 0xEF0000)
    73→; =============================================================================
    74→	org 0EF0000h
    75→
    76→; Jump to Reset_Handler (VGA code is included first for macro definitions)
    77→	jp Reset_Handler
    78→
    79→; =============================================================================
    80→; Include shared VGA I/O and initialization routines
    81→; (defines Write_VGA_Register, VGA_Setup, and macros like VGA_SEQUENCER)
    82→; =============================================================================
    83→	include "vga_io.asm"
    84→	include "vga_init.asm"
    85→	ret			; VGA_Setup has no ret (designed for inline use)
    86→
    87→; =============================================================================
    88→; Entry Point - Called after hardware reset                      [0xEF09C5]
    89→; =============================================================================
    90→Reset_Handler:
    91→	; =========================================================================
    92→	; Minimal hardware initialization (local, trimmed from original)
    93→	; Initializes: watchdog, clock, ports, memory controller, DRAM
    94→	; =========================================================================
    95→	include "boot_hw_init.asm"
    96→
    97→	; Set up stack pointer (after hardware init)
    98→	LDA_XWA_IMM24 STACK_TOP
    99→	ld XSP, XWA
   100→
   101→	; Initialize VGA display using shared code
   102→	CALR VGA_Setup
   103→
   104→	; The shared VGA_Setup leaves registers set for buffer init:
   105→	;   XWA = OFFSCREEN_BUFFER_1, BC = 0808h, DE = 38400
   106→	; We skip the offscreen buffer stuff and just clear video RAM directly
   107→
   108→	; Clear screen to dark blue
   109→	CALR Clear_Screen
   110→
   111→	; Set up additional palette colors (cyan, light gray, yellow)
   112→	CALR Setup_Palette
   113→
   114→	; Draw hexdump of boot code with UI
   115→	CALR Draw_Hexdump
   116→
   117→	; Turn screen on (sequencer clocking mode)
   118→	VGA_SEQUENCER 01h, 001h
   119→
   120→	; TODO: Re-enable serial port code after VGA troubleshooting
   121→	; CALR Serial_Init
   122→	; CALR Send_Serial_Message
   123→
   124→	; Enter infinite loop
   125→Main_Loop:						; [0xEF0B36]
   126→	halt
   127→	jr Main_Loop
   128→
   129→; =============================================================================
   130→; Default_Handler - Default interrupt handler for unused vectors [0xEF0B39]
   131→; =============================================================================
   132→Default_Handler:
   133→	halt
   134→	jr Default_Handler
   135→
   136→; =============================================================================
   137→; Clear_Screen - Fill screen with dark blue (color 8)            [0xEF0B3C]
   138→; =============================================================================
   139→Clear_Screen:
   140→	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
   141→	ld XBC, SCREEN_WIDTH * SCREEN_HEIGHT	; 76800 bytes
   142→	ld A, COLOR_DARK_BLUE
   143→
   144→.clear_loop:
   145→	ld (XDE), A
   146→	inc 1, XDE
   147→	dec 1, XBC
   148→	or XBC, XBC		; Set Z flag based on full 32-bit value
   149→	jr NZ, .clear_loop
   150→
   151→	ret
   152→
   153→; =============================================================================
   154→; Draw_Hexdump - Display hex dump with title, border, and address column
   155→; 8 bytes per line, 27 lines = 216 bytes of boot code
   156→; Input: none
   157→; =============================================================================
   158→Draw_Hexdump:
   159→	; --- Draw title (yellow, centered) ---
   160→	ld (TEXT_COLOR), COLOR_YELLOW
   161→	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Str_Title
   162→	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
   163→	add XDE, 4 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 72	; Y=4, X=72
   164→	CALR Draw_String
   165→
   166→	; --- Draw border ---
   167→	CALR Draw_Border
   168→
   169→	; --- Initialize address buffer with Reset_Handler address ---
   170→	ld (ADDR_BUF), Reset_Handler & 0FFh
   171→	ld (ADDR_BUF + 1), (Reset_Handler >> 8) & 0FFh
   172→	ld (ADDR_BUF + 2), (Reset_Handler >> 16) & 0FFh
   173→
   174→	; --- Set up for data display ---
   175→	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Reset_Handler	; Source: boot code in ROM
   176→	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
   177→	add XDE, 17 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 36 ; Y=17, X=36 (inside border)
   178→
   179→	ld C, 27			; 27 lines
   180→
   181→.line_loop:
   182→	push XDE			; Save line start position
   183→	push XHL			; Save source pointer
   184→	push BC				; Save counters
   185→
   186→	; --- Draw address in cyan (3 bytes = 6 hex digits, tight) ---
   187→	ld (TEXT_COLOR), COLOR_CYAN
   188→
   189→	; High byte of address (byte 2)
   190→	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 2)
   191→	push XDE
   192→	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight
   193→	pop XDE
   194→	add XDE, 16			; Advance past 2 chars
   195→
   196→	; Middle byte of address (byte 1)
   197→	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 1)
   198→	push XDE
   199→	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight
   200→	pop XDE
   201→	add XDE, 16			; Advance past 2 chars
   202→
   203→	; Low byte of address (byte 0)
   204→	ld A, (ADDR_BUF)
   205→	push XDE
   206→	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight
   207→	pop XDE
   208→	add XDE, 16 + 8		; Advance past 2 chars + separator gap
   209→
   210→	; --- Draw 8 data bytes in white ---
   211→	ld (TEXT_COLOR), COLOR_WHITE
   212→	pop BC				; Restore counters
   213→	pop XHL				; Restore source pointer
   214→	ld B, 8				; 8 bytes per line
   215→
   216→.byte_loop:
   217→	push XHL
   218→	push BC
   219→	ld A, (XHL)			; Read byte from ROM
   220→	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte		; Draw "XX " and advance XDE by 24
   221→	pop BC
   222→	pop XHL
   223→
   224→	inc 1, XHL			; Next source byte
   225→	dec 1, B
   226→	or B, B
   227→	jr NZ, .byte_loop
   228→
   229→	; --- Increment address buffer by 8 ---
   230→	ld A, (ADDR_BUF)
   231→	add A, 8
   232→	ld (ADDR_BUF), A
   233→	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 1)
   234→	adc A, 0
   235→	ld (ADDR_BUF + 1), A
   236→	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 2)
   237→	adc A, 0
   238→	ld (ADDR_BUF + 2), A
   239→
   240→	; --- Move to next line ---
   241→	pop XDE				; Restore line start
   242→	add XDE, 8 * SCREEN_WIDTH	; Move down one character row (8 pixels)
   243→	dec 1, C
   244→	or C, C
   245→	jr NZ, .line_loop
   246→
   247→	ret
   248→
   249→; =============================================================================
   250→; Draw_Hex_Byte - Draw one byte as two hex digits plus space gap
   251→; Input: A = byte value, XDE = screen position
   252→; Output: XDE advanced by 24 pixels (3 char widths)
   253→; =============================================================================
   254→Draw_Hex_Byte:
   255→	push WA				; Save original byte
   256→
   257→	; High nibble
   258→	srl 1, A
   259→	srl 1, A
   260→	srl 1, A
   261→	srl 1, A
   262→	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
   263→	push XDE
   264→	CALR Draw_Char
   265→	pop XDE
   266→	add XDE, 8			; Advance one char width
   267→
   268→	; Low nibble
   269→	pop WA				; Restore original byte
   270→	and A, 0Fh
   271→	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
   272→	push XDE
   273→	CALR Draw_Char
   274→	pop XDE
   275→	add XDE, 16			; Advance past char + space gap
   276→
   277→	ret
   278→
   279→; =============================================================================
   280→; Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight - Draw one byte as two hex digits (no trailing space)
   281→; Input: A = byte value, XDE = screen position
   282→; Output: XDE advanced by 16 pixels (2 char widths)
   283→; =============================================================================
   284→Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight:
   285→	push WA				; Save original byte
   286→
   287→	; High nibble
   288→	srl 1, A
   289→	srl 1, A
   290→	srl 1, A
   291→	srl 1, A
   292→	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
   293→	push XDE
   294→	CALR Draw_Char
   295→	pop XDE
   296→	add XDE, 8			; Advance one char width
   297→
   298→	; Low nibble
   299→	pop WA				; Restore original byte
   300→	and A, 0Fh
   301→	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
   302→	push XDE
   303→	CALR Draw_Char
   304→	pop XDE
   305→	add XDE, 8			; Advance one char width (no space gap)
   306→
   307→	ret
   308→
   309→; =============================================================================
   310→; Setup_Palette - Program VGA DAC entries 2-4 for UI colors
   311→; =============================================================================
   312→Setup_Palette:
   313→	; Start writing at palette index 2 (cyan)
   314→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_ADDR_WRITE, COLOR_CYAN
   315→
   316→	; Cyan (R=0, G=0Fh, B=0Fh) - index 2
   317→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0
   318→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Fh
   319→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Fh
   320→
   321→	; Light Gray (R=0Ah, G=0Ah, B=0Ah) - auto-increments to index 3
   322→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Ah
   323→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Ah
   324→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Ah
   325→
   326→	; Yellow (R=0Fh, G=0Fh, B=0) - auto-increments to index 4
   327→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Fh
   328→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Fh
   329→	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0
   330→
   331→	ret
   332→
   333→; =============================================================================
   334→; Draw_Border - Draw bordered frame with vertical separator
   335→; Box: (35,16) to (284,233), separator at X=88
   336→; =============================================================================
   337→Draw_Border:
   338→	ld A, COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY
   339→
   340→	; Top horizontal line: (35, 16), length 250
   341→	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
   342→	add XDE, 16 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 35
   343→	ld BC, 250
   344→	CALR Draw_Hline
   345→
   346→	; Bottom horizontal line: (35, 233), length 250
   347→	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
   348→	add XDE, 233 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 35
   349→	ld BC, 250
   350→	CALR Draw_Hline
   351→
   352→	; Left vertical line: (35, 16), height 218
   353→	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
   354→	add XDE, 16 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 35
   355→	ld BC, 218
   356→	CALR Draw_Vline
   357→
   358→	; Right vertical line: (284, 16), height 218
   359→	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
   360→	add XDE, 16 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 284
   361→	ld BC, 218
   362→	CALR Draw_Vline
   363→
   364→	; Separator vertical line: (88, 16), height 218
   365→	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
   366→	add XDE, 16 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 88
   367→	ld BC, 218
   368→	CALR Draw_Vline
   369→
   370→	ret
   371→
   372→; =============================================================================
   373→; Draw_Hline - Draw horizontal line
   374→; Input: XDE = start VRAM address, BC = length, A = color
   375→; =============================================================================
   376→Draw_Hline:
   377→	ld (XDE), A
   378→	inc 1, XDE
   379→	dec 1, BC
   380→	or BC, BC
   381→	jr NZ, Draw_Hline
   382→	ret
   383→
   384→; =============================================================================
   385→; Draw_Vline - Draw vertical line
   386→; Input: XDE = start VRAM address, BC = height, A = color
   387→; =============================================================================
   388→Draw_Vline:
   389→	ld (XDE), A
   390→	add XDE, SCREEN_WIDTH
   391→	dec 1, BC
   392→	or BC, BC
   393→	jr NZ, Draw_Vline
   394→	ret
   395→
   396→; =============================================================================
   397→; Nibble_To_Ascii - Convert 0-15 to ASCII '0'-'9' or 'A'-'F'
   398→; Input: A = nibble (0-15)
   399→; Output: A = ASCII character
   400→; =============================================================================
   401→Nibble_To_Ascii:
   402→	cp A, 10
   403→	jr C, .digit
   404→	add A, 'A' - 10
   405→	ret
   406→.digit:
   407→	add A, '0'
   408→	ret
   409→
   410→; =============================================================================
   411→; Draw_String - Draw null-terminated string at screen position   [0xEF0B67]
   412→; Input: XHL = string pointer, XDE = screen position (VRAM address)
   413→; =============================================================================
   414→Draw_String:
   415→.draw_loop:
   416→	ld A, (XHL)
   417→	or A, A			; Check for null terminator
   418→	ret Z
   419→
   420→	push XDE
   421→	push XHL
   422→	CALR Draw_Char		; Draw character at (XDE), char in A
   423→	pop XHL
   424→	pop XDE
   425→
   426→	add XDE, 8		; Move to next character position
   427→	inc 1, XHL
   428→	jr .draw_loop
   429→
   430→; =============================================================================
   431→; Draw_Char - Draw a single 8x8 character                        [0xEF0B7E]
   432→; Input: A = ASCII character, XDE = screen position
   433→; =============================================================================
   434→Draw_Char:
   435→	; Calculate font data offset: (A - 32) * 8
   436→	sub A, 32		; ASCII offset
   437→	EXTZ_WA			; Zero-extend A to WA (clears W)
   438→	EXTZ_XWA		; Zero-extend WA to XWA (clears upper 16 bits)
   439→
   440→	; Multiply by 8 (shift left 3)
   441→	sla 1, WA
   442→	sla 1, WA
   443→	sla 1, WA
   444→
   445→	; Get font data address
   446→	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Font_8x8
   447→	add XHL, XWA
   448→
   449→	; Draw 8 rows
   450→	ld C, 8			; Row counter
   451→
   452→.row_loop:
   453→	ld A, (XHL)		; Get font row bitmap
   454→	push XDE
   455→	push XHL
   456→
   457→	; Draw 8 pixels
   458→	ld B, 8			; Column counter
   459→
   460→.pixel_loop:
   461→	bit 7, A		; Test MSB
   462→	jr Z, .skip_pixel
   463→
   464→	; Draw pixel in current text color
   465→	push WA
   466→	ld A, (TEXT_COLOR)
   467→	ld (XDE), A
   468→	pop WA
   469→
   470→.skip_pixel:
   471→	inc 1, XDE
   472→	sla 1, A		; Shift to next bit
   473→	dec 1, B
   474→	or B, B
   475→	jr NZ, .pixel_loop
   476→
   477→	pop XHL
   478→	pop XDE
   479→
   480→	; Move to next row
   481→	add XDE, SCREEN_WIDTH
   482→	inc 1, XHL
   483→	dec 1, C
   484→	or C, C
   485→	jr NZ, .row_loop
   486→
   487→	ret
   488→
   489→; =============================================================================
   490→; Serial_Init - Initialize SC0 for computer interface (38400)    [0xEF0BC1]
   491→; =============================================================================
   492→Serial_Init:
   493→	ld (SC0MOD), SC0MOD_8N1
   494→	ld (BR0CR), BR0CR_38400
   495→	ld (SC0CR), 000h
   496→	ret
   497→
   498→; =============================================================================
   499→; Send_Serial_Message - Send "It is working!" to serial port     [0xEF0BCB]
   500→; =============================================================================
   501→Send_Serial_Message:
   502→	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Str_ItIsWorking
   503→
   504→.send_loop:
   505→	ld A, (XHL)
   506→	or A, A			; Check for null terminator
   507→	ret Z
   508→
   509→	CALR Serial_Send_Byte
   510→	inc 1, XHL
   511→	jr .send_loop
   512→
   513→; =============================================================================
   514→; Serial_Send_Byte - Send single byte via SC0                    [0xEF0BDD]
   515→; Input: A = byte to send
   516→; =============================================================================
   517→Serial_Send_Byte:
   518→	push BC
   519→	push DE
   520→
   521→	; Wait for TX buffer empty (bit 1 of SC0CR) with timeout
   522→	ld DE, 0FFFFh		; Timeout counter
   523→.wait_tx_empty:
   524→	ld C, (SC0CR)
   525→	bit 1, C
   526→	jr NZ, .tx_ready
   527→	dec 1, DE
   528→	or DE, DE
   529→	jr NZ, .wait_tx_empty
   530→	jr .send_done		; Timeout - skip send
   531→
   532→.tx_ready:
   533→	ld (SC0BUF), A
   534→
   535→.send_done:
   536→	pop DE
   537→	pop BC
   538→	ret
   539→
   540→; =============================================================================
   541→; Data Section
   542→; =============================================================================
   543→Str_Title:
   544→	db "KN5000 hexdump utility", 0
   545→
   546→Str_ItIsWorking:
   547→	db "It is working!", 13, 10, 0
   548→
   549→; =============================================================================
   550→; Font Data
   551→; =============================================================================
   552→	include "font_8x8.asm"
   553→
   554→; =============================================================================
   555→; Reset Handler Location                                         [0xFFFEE0]
   556→; =============================================================================
   557→	org 0FFFEE0h
   558→
   559→Reset_Entry:
   560→	jp Reset_Handler
   561→
   562→; =============================================================================
   563→; Fill gap between reset entry and vector table
   564→; =============================================================================
   565→	org 0FFFEE4h
   566→
   567→	rept 01Ch
   568→	db 0FFh
   569→	endm
   570→
   571→; =============================================================================
   572→; Interrupt Vector Table                                         [0xFFFF00]
   573→; =============================================================================
   574→	org 0FFFF00h
   575→
   576→VECTOR_TABLE:
   577→	dd 00FFFEE0h		; Vector 0: Reset
   578→	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 1
   579→	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 2
   580→	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 3
   581→	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 4
   582→	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 5
   583→	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 6
   584→	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 7
   585→
   586→	rept 56
   587→	dd Default_Handler
   588→	endm
   589→
   590→; =============================================================================
   591→; End of ROM
   592→; =============================================================================
   593→	end
   594→

; =============================================================================
; main.asm - Custom KN5000 Boot ROM: Hexdump Utility
; =============================================================================
; A minimal boot ROM for the Technics KN5000 that:
;   1. Initializes essential hardware (watchdog, memory, ports)
;   2. Initializes the VGA display controller
;   3. Displays a hex dump viewer with title, bordered frame, colored
;      address column, and data display of boot code
;   4. Sends "It is working!" to the serial port (computer interface)
;
; Target: TMP94C241F (TLCS-900/H2) @ 25 MHz
; ROM Size: 2MB (0xE00000 - 0xFFFFFF)
; Reset Vector: 0xFFFEE0
;
; Build: make
; Test: Run in MAME kn5000 driver with custom ROM set
;
; This code reuses shared components from ../kn5000-roms-disasm/
; =============================================================================

	cpu 96c141		; TLCS-900/H target
	page 0
	maxmode on

; =============================================================================
; Include shared definitions from kn5000-roms-disasm
; =============================================================================
	include "sfr_tmp94c241.asm"
	include "vga_constants.asm"
	include "tmp94c241.inc"

; Local macros not in the disasm repo
	include "local_macros.inc"

; =============================================================================
; Memory Map Constants
; =============================================================================
STACK_TOP		EQU 001000h	; Stack in internal RAM
OFFSCREEN_BUFFER_1	EQU 280000h	; Offscreen buffer (required by vga_init)

; Screen dimensions
SCREEN_WIDTH		EQU 320
SCREEN_HEIGHT		EQU 240

; Colors (palette indices)
COLOR_BLACK		EQU 0
COLOR_WHITE		EQU 1
COLOR_CYAN		EQU 2		; Address text
COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY	EQU 3		; Borders/separator
COLOR_YELLOW		EQU 4		; Title text
COLOR_DARK_BLUE		EQU 8

; RAM variables (internal RAM, above SFR region)
TEXT_COLOR		EQU 000100h	; 1 byte: current drawing color
ADDR_BUF		EQU 000101h	; 3 bytes: address display value (little-endian)

; Serial port constants
SC0MOD_8N1		EQU 069h	; 8-bit, no parity, 1 stop, baud gen
BR0CR_38400		EQU 006h	; 38400 baud

; =============================================================================
; ROM Layout
; =============================================================================
	org 0E00000h		; Program ROM base address

; Fill with 0xFF until code section
	rept 0F0000h		; ~960KB of padding
	db 0FFh
	endm

; =============================================================================
; Code Section (starts at 0xEF0000)
; =============================================================================
	org 0EF0000h

; Jump to Reset_Handler (VGA code is included first for macro definitions)
	jp Reset_Handler

; =============================================================================
; Include shared VGA I/O and initialization routines
; (defines Write_VGA_Register, VGA_Setup, and macros like VGA_SEQUENCER)
; =============================================================================
	include "vga_io.asm"
	include "vga_init.asm"
	ret			; VGA_Setup has no ret (designed for inline use)

; =============================================================================
; Entry Point - Called after hardware reset                      [0xEF09C5]
; =============================================================================
Reset_Handler:
	; =========================================================================
	; Minimal hardware initialization (local, trimmed from original)
	; Initializes: watchdog, clock, ports, memory controller, DRAM
	; =========================================================================
	include "boot_hw_init.asm"

	; Set up stack pointer (after hardware init)
	LDA_XWA_IMM24 STACK_TOP
	ld XSP, XWA

	; Initialize VGA display using shared code
	CALR VGA_Setup

	; The shared VGA_Setup leaves registers set for buffer init:
	;   XWA = OFFSCREEN_BUFFER_1, BC = 0808h, DE = 38400
	; We skip the offscreen buffer stuff and just clear video RAM directly

	; Clear screen to dark blue
	CALR Clear_Screen

	; Set up additional palette colors (cyan, light gray, yellow)
	CALR Setup_Palette

	; Draw hexdump of boot code with UI
	CALR Draw_Hexdump

	; Turn screen on (sequencer clocking mode)
	VGA_SEQUENCER 01h, 001h

	; TODO: Re-enable serial port code after VGA troubleshooting
	; CALR Serial_Init
	; CALR Send_Serial_Message

	; Enter infinite loop
Main_Loop:						; [0xEF0B36]
	halt
	jr Main_Loop

; =============================================================================
; Default_Handler - Default interrupt handler for unused vectors [0xEF0B39]
; =============================================================================
Default_Handler:
	halt
	jr Default_Handler

; =============================================================================
; Clear_Screen - Fill screen with dark blue (color 8)            [0xEF0B3C]
; =============================================================================
Clear_Screen:
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	ld XBC, SCREEN_WIDTH * SCREEN_HEIGHT	; 76800 bytes
	ld A, COLOR_DARK_BLUE

.clear_loop:
	ld (XDE), A
	inc 1, XDE
	dec 1, XBC
	or XBC, XBC		; Set Z flag based on full 32-bit value
	jr NZ, .clear_loop

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Hexdump - Display hex dump with title, border, and address column
; 8 bytes per line, 27 lines = 216 bytes of boot code
; Input: none
; =============================================================================
Draw_Hexdump:
	; --- Draw title (yellow, centered) ---
	ld (TEXT_COLOR), COLOR_YELLOW
	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Str_Title
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	add XDE, 4 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 72	; Y=4, X=72
	CALR Draw_String

	; --- Draw border ---
	CALR Draw_Border

	; --- Initialize address buffer with Reset_Handler address ---
	ld (ADDR_BUF), Reset_Handler & 0FFh
	ld (ADDR_BUF + 1), (Reset_Handler >> 8) & 0FFh
	ld (ADDR_BUF + 2), (Reset_Handler >> 16) & 0FFh

	; --- Set up for data display ---
	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Reset_Handler	; Source: boot code in ROM
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	add XDE, 17 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 36 ; Y=17, X=36 (inside border)

	ld C, 27			; 27 lines

.line_loop:
	push XDE			; Save line start position
	push XHL			; Save source pointer
	push BC				; Save counters

	; --- Draw address in cyan (3 bytes = 6 hex digits, tight) ---
	ld (TEXT_COLOR), COLOR_CYAN

	; High byte of address (byte 2)
	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 2)
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 16			; Advance past 2 chars

	; Middle byte of address (byte 1)
	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 1)
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 16			; Advance past 2 chars

	; Low byte of address (byte 0)
	ld A, (ADDR_BUF)
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 16 + 8		; Advance past 2 chars + separator gap

	; --- Draw 8 data bytes in white ---
	ld (TEXT_COLOR), COLOR_WHITE
	pop BC				; Restore counters
	pop XHL				; Restore source pointer
	ld B, 8				; 8 bytes per line

.byte_loop:
	push XHL
	push BC
	ld A, (XHL)			; Read byte from ROM
	CALR Draw_Hex_Byte		; Draw "XX " and advance XDE by 24
	pop BC
	pop XHL

	inc 1, XHL			; Next source byte
	dec 1, B
	or B, B
	jr NZ, .byte_loop

	; --- Increment address buffer by 8 ---
	ld A, (ADDR_BUF)
	add A, 8
	ld (ADDR_BUF), A
	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 1)
	adc A, 0
	ld (ADDR_BUF + 1), A
	ld A, (ADDR_BUF + 2)
	adc A, 0
	ld (ADDR_BUF + 2), A

	; --- Move to next line ---
	pop XDE				; Restore line start
	add XDE, 8 * SCREEN_WIDTH	; Move down one character row (8 pixels)
	dec 1, C
	or C, C
	jr NZ, .line_loop

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Hex_Byte - Draw one byte as two hex digits plus space gap
; Input: A = byte value, XDE = screen position
; Output: XDE advanced by 24 pixels (3 char widths)
; =============================================================================
Draw_Hex_Byte:
	push WA				; Save original byte

	; High nibble
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Char
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 8			; Advance one char width

	; Low nibble
	pop WA				; Restore original byte
	and A, 0Fh
	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Char
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 16			; Advance past char + space gap

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight - Draw one byte as two hex digits (no trailing space)
; Input: A = byte value, XDE = screen position
; Output: XDE advanced by 16 pixels (2 char widths)
; =============================================================================
Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight:
	push WA				; Save original byte

	; High nibble
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	srl 1, A
	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Char
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 8			; Advance one char width

	; Low nibble
	pop WA				; Restore original byte
	and A, 0Fh
	CALR Nibble_To_Ascii
	push XDE
	CALR Draw_Char
	pop XDE
	add XDE, 8			; Advance one char width (no space gap)

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Setup_Palette - Program VGA DAC entries 2-4 for UI colors
; =============================================================================
Setup_Palette:
	; Start writing at palette index 2 (cyan)
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_ADDR_WRITE, COLOR_CYAN

	; Cyan (R=0, G=0Fh, B=0Fh) - index 2
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Fh
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Fh

	; Light Gray (R=0Ah, G=0Ah, B=0Ah) - auto-increments to index 3
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Ah
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Ah
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Ah

	; Yellow (R=0Fh, G=0Fh, B=0) - auto-increments to index 4
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Fh
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0Fh
	VGA_WRITE VGA_DAC_DATA, 0

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Border - Draw bordered frame with vertical separator
; Box: (35,16) to (284,233), separator at X=88
; =============================================================================
Draw_Border:
	ld A, COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY

	; Top horizontal line: (35, 16), length 250
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	add XDE, 16 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 35
	ld BC, 250
	CALR Draw_Hline

	; Bottom horizontal line: (35, 233), length 250
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	add XDE, 233 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 35
	ld BC, 250
	CALR Draw_Hline

	; Left vertical line: (35, 16), height 218
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	add XDE, 16 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 35
	ld BC, 218
	CALR Draw_Vline

	; Right vertical line: (284, 16), height 218
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	add XDE, 16 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 284
	ld BC, 218
	CALR Draw_Vline

	; Separator vertical line: (88, 16), height 218
	LDA_XDE_IMM24 VIDEO_RAM_BASE
	add XDE, 16 * SCREEN_WIDTH + 88
	ld BC, 218
	CALR Draw_Vline

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Hline - Draw horizontal line
; Input: XDE = start VRAM address, BC = length, A = color
; =============================================================================
Draw_Hline:
	ld (XDE), A
	inc 1, XDE
	dec 1, BC
	or BC, BC
	jr NZ, Draw_Hline
	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Vline - Draw vertical line
; Input: XDE = start VRAM address, BC = height, A = color
; =============================================================================
Draw_Vline:
	ld (XDE), A
	add XDE, SCREEN_WIDTH
	dec 1, BC
	or BC, BC
	jr NZ, Draw_Vline
	ret

; =============================================================================
; Nibble_To_Ascii - Convert 0-15 to ASCII '0'-'9' or 'A'-'F'
; Input: A = nibble (0-15)
; Output: A = ASCII character
; =============================================================================
Nibble_To_Ascii:
	cp A, 10
	jr C, .digit
	add A, 'A' - 10
	ret
.digit:
	add A, '0'
	ret

; =============================================================================
; Draw_String - Draw null-terminated string at screen position   [0xEF0B67]
; Input: XHL = string pointer, XDE = screen position (VRAM address)
; =============================================================================
Draw_String:
.draw_loop:
	ld A, (XHL)
	or A, A			; Check for null terminator
	ret Z

	push XDE
	push XHL
	CALR Draw_Char		; Draw character at (XDE), char in A
	pop XHL
	pop XDE

	add XDE, 8		; Move to next character position
	inc 1, XHL
	jr .draw_loop

; =============================================================================
; Draw_Char - Draw a single 8x8 character                        [0xEF0B7E]
; Input: A = ASCII character, XDE = screen position
; =============================================================================
Draw_Char:
	; Calculate font data offset: (A - 32) * 8
	sub A, 32		; ASCII offset
	EXTZ_WA			; Zero-extend A to WA (clears W)
	EXTZ_XWA		; Zero-extend WA to XWA (clears upper 16 bits)

	; Multiply by 8 (shift left 3)
	sla 1, WA
	sla 1, WA
	sla 1, WA

	; Get font data address
	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Font_8x8
	add XHL, XWA

	; Draw 8 rows
	ld C, 8			; Row counter

.row_loop:
	ld A, (XHL)		; Get font row bitmap
	push XDE
	push XHL

	; Draw 8 pixels
	ld B, 8			; Column counter

.pixel_loop:
	bit 7, A		; Test MSB
	jr Z, .skip_pixel

	; Draw pixel in current text color
	push WA
	ld A, (TEXT_COLOR)
	ld (XDE), A
	pop WA

.skip_pixel:
	inc 1, XDE
	sla 1, A		; Shift to next bit
	dec 1, B
	or B, B
	jr NZ, .pixel_loop

	pop XHL
	pop XDE

	; Move to next row
	add XDE, SCREEN_WIDTH
	inc 1, XHL
	dec 1, C
	or C, C
	jr NZ, .row_loop

	ret

; =============================================================================
; Serial_Init - Initialize SC0 for computer interface (38400)    [0xEF0BC1]
; =============================================================================
Serial_Init:
	ld (SC0MOD), SC0MOD_8N1
	ld (BR0CR), BR0CR_38400
	ld (SC0CR), 000h
	ret

; =============================================================================
; Send_Serial_Message - Send "It is working!" to serial port     [0xEF0BCB]
; =============================================================================
Send_Serial_Message:
	LDA_XHL_IMM24 Str_ItIsWorking

.send_loop:
	ld A, (XHL)
	or A, A			; Check for null terminator
	ret Z

	CALR Serial_Send_Byte
	inc 1, XHL
	jr .send_loop

; =============================================================================
; Serial_Send_Byte - Send single byte via SC0                    [0xEF0BDD]
; Input: A = byte to send
; =============================================================================
Serial_Send_Byte:
	push BC
	push DE

	; Wait for TX buffer empty (bit 1 of SC0CR) with timeout
	ld DE, 0FFFFh		; Timeout counter
.wait_tx_empty:
	ld C, (SC0CR)
	bit 1, C
	jr NZ, .tx_ready
	dec 1, DE
	or DE, DE
	jr NZ, .wait_tx_empty
	jr .send_done		; Timeout - skip send

.tx_ready:
	ld (SC0BUF), A

.send_done:
	pop DE
	pop BC
	ret

; =============================================================================
; Data Section
; =============================================================================
Str_Title:
	db "KN5000 hexdump utility", 0

Str_ItIsWorking:
	db "It is working!", 13, 10, 0

; =============================================================================
; Font Data
; =============================================================================
	include "font_8x8.asm"

; =============================================================================
; Reset Handler Location                                         [0xFFFEE0]
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFEE0h

Reset_Entry:
	jp Reset_Handler

; =============================================================================
; Fill gap between reset entry and vector table
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFEE4h

	rept 01Ch
	db 0FFh
	endm

; =============================================================================
; Interrupt Vector Table                                         [0xFFFF00]
; =============================================================================
	org 0FFFF00h

VECTOR_TABLE:
	dd 00FFFEE0h		; Vector 0: Reset
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 1
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 2
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 3
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 4
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 5
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 6
	dd Default_Handler	; Vector 7

	rept 56
	dd Default_Handler
	endm

; =============================================================================
; End of ROM
; =============================================================================
	end

content.text:
The `LDA_XDE_IMM24` macro is just an `lda XDE, (imm24)` instruction encoding. It loads XDE with the immediate address value - it doesn't touch registers A/W. The macro generates raw bytes for the instruction. So XDE is modified but A is preserved.

However, Draw_Hline and Draw_Vline loops use A, and the `Draw_Hline`/`Draw_Vline` calls will return with A intact (it's never modified in those routines - just read from). But the issue is actually that `LDA_XDE_IMM24` modifies XDE (loading the base address), then `add XDE` adjusts it. `A` is set at the start and is only read (never written) by Draw_Hline/Draw_Vline. So `A` stays as `COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY` throughout. 

Wait - looking more carefully at `Draw_Border`: After each `CALR Draw_Hline` or `CALR Draw_Vline`, those routines modify `XDE`, `BC`, and `A` is only read, never written. So `A` should persist across all 5 calls. Good.

Actually wait, I need to reconsider. `LDA_XDE_IMM24` is a `lda` instruction which loads an effective address. Let me check: `lda XDE, (imm24)` - this just loads the immediate value into XDE. It doesn't touch A. And Draw_Hline/Draw_Vline only read from A (via `ld (XDE), A`), they don't modify it. So A = COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY is preserved throughout Draw_Border.

content.text:
All done. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

**Changes to `src/main.asm`:**

1. **New color constants**: `COLOR_CYAN` (2), `COLOR_LIGHT_GRAY` (3), `COLOR_YELLOW` (4) and RAM variables `TEXT_COLOR` (0x100), `ADDR_BUF` (0x101-0x103)

2. **`Setup_Palette`** routine: Programs VGA DAC entries 2-4 with cyan, light gray, and yellow colors using the existing `VGA_WRITE` macro

3. **`Draw_Char` modified**: Now reads color from `TEXT_COLOR` RAM variable instead of hardcoded `COLOR_WHITE`

4. **`Draw_Hexdump` rewritten**: 
   - Draws yellow title "KN5000 hexdump utility" centered at Y=4
   - Calls `Draw_Border` for the frame
   - Initializes `ADDR_BUF` with the `Reset_Handler` address
   - Loops 27 lines, drawing cyan 6-digit addresses and white data bytes (8 per line)
   - Increments the address buffer by 8 each line with carry propagation

5. **New routines**:
   - `Draw_Hex_Byte_Tight` - Like `Draw_Hex_Byte` but no trailing space (16px advance vs 24px)
   - `Draw_Border` - Draws rectangle border at (35,16)-(284,233) plus vertical separator at X=88
   - `Draw_Hline` - Horizontal line drawing
   - `Draw_Vline` - Vertical line drawing

6. **`Str_Title`** data string added

The ROM builds successfully at 2MB and the ROM set is ready to test with `make test`.

content.thinking:
OK, now I see the issues clearly. Let me fix them:

1. `ld (TEXT_COLOR), COLOR_YELLOW` — ASL may generate a wider-than-byte store for `ld (addr16), imm`, corrupting adjacent ADDR_BUF bytes. Fix: use `ld A, imm / ld (TEXT_COLOR), A` for unambiguous byte stores.

2. `ld (ADDR_BUF + 1), (Reset_Handler >> 8) & 0FFh` — The `(` before `Reset_Handler` may be parsed as memory indirection. Fix: use register-mediated stores without expression parentheses.


3. The same multi-byte store issue affects the loop where I'm setting TEXT_COLOR to cyan—it's zeroing ADDR_BUF on each iteration, so I need to switch to register-mediated stores there too. Also, the user actually wants addresses displayed in light gray instead of cyan, so I'll need to change that color constant as well.

Let me apply all four fixes now.

content.text:
I see two root causes:

1. **`ld (addr16), immediate`** — ASL may generate wider-than-byte stores for `ld (TEXT_COLOR), imm`, which would overwrite adjacent ADDR_BUF bytes (TEXT_COLOR is at 0x100, ADDR_BUF starts at 0x101). The `ld (TEXT_COLOR), COLOR_CYAN` inside the loop would zero ADDR_BUF every iteration.

2. **Parentheses as indirection** — `(Reset_Handler >> 8) & 0FFh` may parse the `(` as memory indirection instead of expression grouping.

Fix: use register-mediated byte stores everywhere, remove expression parentheses, and change address color to light gray.
